commit.message:
goal/3300: re-anchor the content commit for the two review gates (#3615)

No content. The three seat merges of master (cd6c61d0, cbd233de, fc9f8a9a)
were titled "Merge master into …", which the specs reviewer's is_merge
(headline-prefix match: "Merge branch …") reads as content while the code
reviewer reads them as merges. Result: the code reviewer stands aside on
its 17:52 approval, the specs reviewer waits for a code approval newer than
fc9f8a9a — a deadlock. A non-merge commit gives both one content commit.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

gateway: wire-quarry — a 404 on GET /wire is the silent door, never an empty index (#3615 review)

GW-WIRE-VIEW: the door always answers its index (an empty `sources` when
nothing is recorded); only GET /wire/<source> answers 404. index() turned
any non-200 into [], so `list` / `find` against a gateway without the door
(today's deployed image, until #3328) or a wrong WIRE_DOOR_URL printed
nothing and exited 0. Now any non-200 on /wire exits 3 naming the door.

GW-WIRE-QUARRY: new row "a server with no wire door is a silent door, never
an empty index ⚖" + legend value `no wire door`; the exit-code prose says
what silent covers. Red before the fix (exit expected 3, got 0), green after.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
